facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
facts.statement: Construction of the new headquarters at Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The Great British Railways headquarters site in Derby will accommodate up to 450 staff.

facts.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy

facts.statement: Since bringing operators' services into public ownership, fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years and 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the network.
